title: Choosing the Right Passive
goal: Choose between the active, the passive with ser, passive se and estar + participle.

items: I can choose between an active verb, the passive with *ser*, passive *se* and *estar* + participle.
I can name the doer with *por* only when it matters.
I can use the new words for announcements and agreements.
